Simulated Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) Dataset

Source: R/data.R
dvt_data.Rd

A simulated dataset of 9,805 patients from seven studies, used to illustrate the development of a clinical prediction model for diagnosing deep vein thrombosis (DVT). All predictors are binary (0/1).

Usage

dvt_data

Format

A data frame with 9,805 rows and 12 columns:

male

Male sex (1 = male)

OCuse

Oral contraceptive use (1 = yes)

malignancy

Active malignancy/cancer (1 = yes)

surgery

Recent surgery (1 = yes)

ab_leg_trauma

Recent leg trauma (1 = yes)

vein_distension

Leg vein distension/swelling (1 = yes)

calf_diff

Calf width difference >3 cm (1 = yes)

ab_ddimer

Abnormal D-dimer blood test result (1 = yes)

pregnancy

Recent pregnancy (1 = yes)

immobile

Recent immobility >24 hours (1 = yes)

clotting

Recent anticoagulant use (1 = yes)

dvt

DVT diagnosis (1 = DVT present; outcome variable)

Source

Simulated dataset provided for illustrative purposes.

Details

Outcome prevalence is approximately 21%. The dataset spans seven studies of varying size. It is intended as a realistic example of a modest-sized development dataset for use with the generalised sample size approach (pmgen_reference(), pmgen_simulate()).
